about: Movement, tuned toward fast arena-shooter feel (Apex-style) on Skyrim's controller. Speeds in Skyrim units per second unless noted.

rows.what: extra SpeedMult always (Skyrim's run feels sluggish)
extra SpeedMult while sprinting
sprint + crouch: slide at max(this, your speed x1.2), steerable a little, easing off over durationMs (Apex-style)
(unused: the slide drives velocity directly now)
jumping keeps this share of your ground or slide speed into the air (momentum carry)
air strafing acceleration (units/s^2), from 0.12 s after takeoff; never touches vertical speed
cap on horizontal air speed from strafing; 0 = your takeoff speed
multiplier on Skyrim's sprint stamina drain
multiplier on Skyrim's jump height
field of view while aiming down sights with a gun (degrees)
SpeedMult change while aiming down sights
Camera field of view, first and third person (Skyrim default 70)
First-person hands/weapon field of view (Skyrim default 65)
frame rate cap; 0 = unlimited (VSync is switched off by the mod and Havok's step follows the frame time, so any frame rate is safe)
How far in front of the eye the gun grip sits while aiming down sights (units)
How far below the line of sight the wand sits while aiming (units)
First-person weapon field of view while aiming down sights (degrees)
left/right running speed as a share of forward (Skyrim ~0.8; Apex-like 0.97)
backward running speed as a share of forward
how fast ground speed follows your input (1/s): higher = snappier direction changes, no ice-skating
turning while running/sprinting (Skyrim rotateWhileMovingRun multiplier)
